title: Seasonal Food and Beverage Minimums for Resort Club Memberships
content:
Three levels of Resort Club Memberships carry a monthly food and beverage minimum during the minimum season: the amount of food and beverage a member must charge in each month of that season.

| Membership level | Monthly food and beverage minimum (USD) | Months in which the minimum applies |
|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 0.00 (none) | None |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 0.00 (none) | None |
| Spa Club Membership | 0.00 (none) | None |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 50.00 | May, June, July, August and September (months 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9) |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 75.00 | May, June, July, August and September (months 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9) |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 150.00 | May, June, July, August and September (months 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9) |

## Reading the table

- A minimum of 0.00 with no listed months means the level has no food and beverage minimum.
- The minimum season is the same five calendar months at each of the three levels that carry a minimum.
- The figure is a monthly amount: a Founders Resort Club Membership member's minimum is 150.00 in each of May, June, July, August and September, not 150.00 across the season.
